definition.cap_policy: no proof plus a cap is unresolved and excluded; an existence proof resolves contact
definition.database: no probe required: all decision targets have >8 pieces and material cannot increase
definition.draw_history: ignored in enumeration (conservative); replayed witnesses may not continue past a draw
definition.evaluation: master builtin net, static only; Black POV for common summaries
definition.selection: ascending SHA256(decimal seed + NUL + canonical final FEN)
definition.strict_boundary_policy: recheck only initially exhausted clean cases; opening side to move only
definition.strict_own_miss: all legal non-avoided moves; all moves if all avoided

h1_diagnostics.reason_in_table: B means barred; no per-ballot explanation or lost side is supplied
